jobs.title: Regional Director
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

JOB DESCRIPTION

BGIS is a leading provider of customized facility management and real estate services. With a combined team of over 10,000 professionals worldwide, we relentlessly focus on enabling innovation through the services we deliver. We actively seek new opportunities that drive innovation for our clients’ businesses. Globally, we manager over 320 million square feet of client portfolios across 30,000+ locations in North America, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia. For further information, visit www.bgis.com .

OUR CULTURE

At BGIS, our culture is built on three foundational pillars:

Culture of Care: We deeply care for each other, our clients, partners, and the communities we serve.
High Performing Teams: We go Above and Beyond to deliver exceptional services. INTEGRITY, OWNERSHIP, RESPONSIVENESS, INITIATION, VISIBILITY, DRIVE, and INTEGRATION are core to high performance.
Unwavering Commitment to Sustainability: We conduct every action with a focus on preserving our earth.

SUMMARY

For the assigned region(s), the Regional Director
is accountable for operations, financial management and meeting service delivery obligations in a specified Geographical region that includes several facilities, employees and clients.  This role is expected to understand, coach and train the team in all regulatory and client requirements.  In addition, this role is also responsible for contributing to strategic and account management plans and objectives and people leadership. 

This role will work in collaboration with all key BGIS departments to ensure full support of all activities and play a key role in our INTEGRATED approach to operating buildings.   

Opportunities for Development:  

At BGIS we are committed to the development of our people – offering them opportunities to learn and grow into various roles.  Success in the role offers Team Members the opportunity to explore various roles – some include:  

On Account and expanded Operational Leadership
Facility Management Office roles to support accounts,
Project Management leadership roles to lead and execute projects

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Health, Safety, Environment & Security

Follow and apply all Health and Safety and Emergency Response, aligned with both BGIS and Client expectations.to ensure safety of all employees and building occupants. 
Work in collaboration with BGIS Health Safety and Environment Teams for support and direction on key programs to emphasize Safety Culture 
Accountable for meeting all internal and external health, safety, environment and security-related requirements 
Accountable for the safe delivery of all work performed  

Account Management

Continuously engages clients in discussions to understand and anticipate needs, identify and recommend additional services   
Provides input and contributes to the development and execution of strategic account expansion plans 
Recommends additional pull-through services 
Participates in and contributes to quarterly business reviews 
Contributes to contract renewal and business development activities 
Contributes to account governance  
Adherence to Contract Specific MSA (Master Service Agreement)  
Manages the BGIS ECE Program for the specific client group 
Responsible for results and action plans related to the Likely to Recommend Survey.  

Client Relationship Management

Accountable for achieving client satisfaction objectives for the assigned region(s) 
Accountable for developing and maintaining effective relationships with clients, managing client expectations 
Position level of client representatives with whom this position typically interacts with include those at the senior management level 
Acts as the focal point of escalation for issues pertaining to facilities within assigned region(s) 

Region/Portfolio Budget Development & Management

Assume financial responsibility for facility operations, including budget management. 
In partnership with finance, responsible for the development of budgets (O&M, Transaction, capital projects and rent), and be able to support and explain approach to the client and the account team.  
Using financial reports, perform monthly budget, analyze and re-forecast allocations as necessary. 
Meet annual targets as per contractual performance and client financial targets / indicators. 
Identify cost-saving opportunities and develop strategies to maximize financial resources. 
Track and report on budget positive or negative trends performance regularly 
Participates in, provides recommendations, and contributes to continuous improvement projects to achieve efficiency gains and cost savings 

Portfolio Management

Accountable for operations management for the portfolio of facilities within the assigned region(s) 
Leads the operations and maintenance activities of a portfolio of facilities along with the execution of the portfolio’s programs 
Oversees the completion and submission of capital plans 
Creates and implements short to mid-term plans for the assigned region(s) 
Provides input into strategic plans   
Collaborates with relevant stakeholders to optimize facilities within assigned region(s) and continuously create value for the client. 

Service Delivery Management

Work in collaboration with Central Work Order Management Team to ensure all work is being completed as outlined in the MSA 
Monitor work order progress and ensure tasks are completed within established timelines. 
Work with Account Governance Teams to maintain accurate records of work orders and associated costs. 
Streamline and manage work order processes to optimize efficiency. 
Prioritize and assign work orders based on urgency and impact on facility operations. 
Accountable for meeting all service obligations for the assigned region(s) 
Oversees the delivery of all service obligations 
Accountable for meeting established metrics/key performance indicators.  Leads the operations team in the development and implementation of action plans to remediate gaps, where applicable, to ensure objectives are met. 
Accountable for ensuring compliance to all legislated, corporate and industry-related requirements and guidelines including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, and building standard requirements 

Risk Management, Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity Planning and Execution

Accountable for safeguarding the client against emergencies and risks by ensuring emergency preparedness, risk management, disaster recovery and business continuity plans are developed and that relevant stakeholders are trained to ensure proper execution 
Oversight and engagement in Emergency Management 

Regulatory Compliance

Accountable for ensuring all regulatory compliance requirements have been met and all related documentation are created and maintained 
Ensure compliance with corporate and legislated policies, procedures, practices and guidelines related to environmental, building code and issues by applying cursory knowledge of legislation related to these areas 

Project Management

Accountable for on-time, on-budget and quality delivery of facility management projects for the assigned region(s) 
Collaborates with clients and internal stakeholders to identify project opportunities and priorities, develop and implement projects 
Oversees the development and execution of project plans for portfolios within assigned region(s) 

Procurement

With Support from BGIS Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Leadership – follow BGIS Vendor Performance and Relationship Management Program protocols  
Collaborates with Procurement and Supply Chain Administration teams to source and qualify vendors, source and procure goods and services. 

Continuous Improvement

Collaborates with stakeholders and contributes to efficiency gains   through activities including but not limited to identifying and implementing best practices; reviewing, refining and/or developing, implementing processes, technologies and sustainable practices, and leveraging self-perform wherever possible.  Implements related enhancements for the assigned region(s) 

Leadership and Recognition

Accountable for employee-oriented activities including but not limited to employee engagement, development and performance management, hiring and retention, compensation recommendations 
Employee Satisfaction Scores and employee recognition (development and implementation of action plans to improve ESAT scores) 
Day to day support and team oversight/management 

Collaboration with BGIS Self Perform Teams delivering Best Quality Services to Buildings 

Work in collaboration with BGIS teams in Janitorial, Project Management and TechnicalServices or any other areas where work is directly performed by BGIS to maximize efficiency and the best customer service in the buildings / portfolios  
Work together with these teams to ensure work is completed 

Technology to Support your Success. 

Leverage technology such as work order system, vendor monitoring tools, BAS and CMMS scheduling tools to deliver effective service to clients.  
Mentor staff in vendor management and the effective use of technology for vendor relationships. 
Provide guidance to team members on the effective use of technology for financial management and career progression. 
Other duties as assigned 

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

Community college diploma preferably in business administration
More than 10 years of facility management work experience
Highly skilled at account management
Highly skilled at facility operations management
Highly skilled at client relationship management with demonstrated ability in building and managing relationships with client representatives at the senior management level
Highly skilled at managing service delivery and meeting service delivery obligations
Skilled at managing budgets
Fully developed communication, influence, persuasion and negotiation skills
High degree of client service orientation and sense of urgency
Highly skilled at leading and engaging a team of individuals
Skilled at vendor management
Highly skilled at emergency management, emergency preparedness and business continuity planning and execution
Possesses a sustainability mindset and seeks to incorporate sustainable practices within assigned portfolio where possible
Expert level knowledge of health and safety requirements. Possesses a high degree of safety mindset
Maintains current knowledge of and highly skilled at implementing facility management services best practices
Expert level knowledge of current building standards and requirements
Possesses a continuous improvement and quality mindset along with a desire to continuously seek and incorporate innovative practices and technologies in order to deliver value to the client

Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation

One or more of the following would be considered an asset:

Certified Facility Manager from International Facility Management Association
Certified Property Manager from Institute of Real Estate Management
Facility Management Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute
Real Property Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $110,000 - $138,000 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.

BGIS is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome you to apply for a position with us! If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact us at askHR. Upon request for accommodation, we will consult with the applicant in question and provide, or arrange for the provision of, suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability.

jobs.title: Director, Finance (CSM)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.title: Head of Sales │ Chef des ventes
jobs.description:
Head of Sales

A rare role: you report directly to the CEO and take over a strong, proven sales function, processes, lead generation, CRM, KPI dashboards, go to market strategy and metrics already in place, and take it further. We're looking for a leader and coach who isn't afraid to be in the trenches with the reps and the clients, side by side, so that deals get won. Someone who raises the bar, grows the team, keeps everybody accountable and makes every seller better.

About Us:

Evvo is a dynamic clean-tech company that has grown by over 700% in the last five years. We lean on circular economy principles to make mobile device management a breeze for big companies and governments. We help stretch the lifespan of smartphones and tablets while lightening the load for our clients' IT teams, what we call delegated device management. Thanks to our tech and management processes, our clients see real savings, tighter data security, and free up their IT folks for more strategic projects.

At Evvo, we thrive on ambitious, high-impact ideas. We aim to revolutionize our industry, become the market leader, and save the planet—one electronic device at a time.

What You Will Do

Report directly to the CEO and take our current sales structure further: set the annual plan and priorities, and own the monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts.
Lead, coach and train a growing team of sales professionals.
Shadow live calls, discovery meetings and demos on a set rotation, give same-day feedback, and run hands-on training (discovery, objection handling, pricing conversations, MEDDICS, role-plays, call reviews).
Be on the ground every week: meet clients and partners alongside your reps so deals get won, build personal relationships with key executives and partners, attend industry events, and co-lead the largest strategic opportunities as executive sponsor.
Set objectives and run weekly 1:1s, pipeline reviews and quarterly performance reviews for every team member.
Grow the team from 3 to 5 or 6 people by the end of the year: always be recruiting, forecast talent needs and run a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding for each role.
Strengthen retention and growth in the installed base: work with Customer Success on health scoring, the renewal calendar and quarterly business reviews, and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
Own the sales process, CRM and forecast: keep stage criteria, next-step discipline and handoff rules in NetSuite sharp, deliver a weekly pipeline report and a monthly forecast to the CEO and CFO, and keep improving the process with win/loss data.
Own the sales tech stack (NetSuite CRM, Apollo.io, Claude AI), get more out of it, and train the team to be AI-fluent.
With the external marketing consultant, align marketing and ABM campaigns with Sales priorities on target accounts. Run A/B tests with success criteria set in advance, and ensure sales assets stay sharp and current.
Work with the product team: bring structured client feedback and post-mortems on won and lost accounts to keep improving product-market fit.
Support acquisitions: when Evvo acquires a company, join the integration team on the commercial side. Assess the acquired client base, sales team, comp plan and offers, plan the integration of teams, tools and pipeline, then lead client communication and cross-selling.

In 12 Months, You Will Have

Lifted team performance through hands-on coaching: stronger discovery, pitching and closing, with more deals won alongside you.
Grown the team from 3 to 5 or 6 people by year-end and built a confident, accountable group: written quarterly objectives, a steady coaching rhythm and new sellers ramping on plan.
Diversified our client base with new logos, backed by a pipeline that comfortably covers the target.
Delivered a forecast the CEO and CFO can trust, with a next step and a date on every open opportunity.
Secured the installed base: every renewal reviewed well ahead of its end date and every at-risk account covered by a documented action plan.
Aligned Sales and Marketing: ABM campaigns focused on target accounts, up-to-date sales assets, and every A/B test closed with a documented decision.
Taken our sales process further: sharper stage discipline in the CRM, refined every month from win/loss data and what the team learns.

What We Are Looking For

A track record as a leader and coach of a sales team: you have built and developed elite sales professionals, taking into account coaching, tough love, and hard managerial decisions when needed.
Experience growing and diversifying a B2B technology or managed-services client base. Telecom, mobility management or IT services is an asset.
Mastery of complex enterprise sales with long cycles (6 to 18 months) and multiple decision-makers, with credibility in front of C-level buyers and public-sector procurement.
A boots on the ground mentality: you are not afraid to be in the room with reps, partners and clients. Most of your week is spent with them, and the rest on planning, execution and reporting.
Experience scaling an existing sales function.
A natural relationship builder, at ease hosting partners, clients and executives.
Discipline, accountability and data accuracy (CRM, forecasting) as non-negotiables.
A high degree of initiative: you don't wait to be asked, you execute fast.
High comfort with AI tools to scale the team.
Fluency in French and English.
Passionate about making a positive impact on the environment.
A plus: knowledge of device lifecycle management, MDM, ITSM (ServiceNow), Managed Services or Telecom expense management.

What We Offer You

Full-time, permanent position.
Minimum of 3 weeks vacation + additional time off during the holiday season.
Flexible hybrid work (minimum 3 days per week in our modern offices in the Old Port of Montréal; the rest remote or on client and partner sites). Travel outside the city about once a month, for 2 to 4 days.
Group insurance and RRSP
‍⚕ 24/7 online access to a doctor for you and your family
Top-tier tech and AI tools so you can perform at your full potential.
‍‍ Humans first: scheduling flexibility for the unexpected, a listening ear, and victories we celebrate together. Here, you are not a number.
Team events, happy hours, and celebrations for our major successes
Be part of a dynamic and dedicated team, committed to creating tools and solutions that make a real difference for our planet.

What to expect next?

We value your time and clear communication. Here are the steps in our hiring process:

Discovery interview with our Talent acquisition Manager (30 min): a phone discussion to get to know each other, discuss the role and your aspirations.
Second interview with recruiting manager (1h): a more in-depth discussion via video conference about the role, your vision for growth and your experience.
Practical interview with our CEO (1h30): you receive a case 72 hours ahead and present your approach in our offices. You'll also meet a member of your future team.
Job Offer, References & Background Check: The moment we've been waiting for! We make you an offer, speak with your references, and conduct a background check.
Onboarding: Welcome to Evvo! We've prepared everything for a smooth arrival: your tools are waiting for you, and the team is excited to meet and train you so you can thrive quickly.

Our Hiring Philosophy:

We like to keep things moving! We commit to keeping you informed, regardless of the outcome; here, we don't "ghost" anyone. We aim for a thorough and rigorous evaluation, but always efficient.

Chef des ventes

Un rôle rare : vous relevez directement du PDG et prenez en charge une fonction commerciale solide et éprouvée, des processus, la génération de pistes, un CRM, des tableaux de bord de KPI, une stratégie d'accès au marché et des métriques déjà en place, pour les amener encore plus loin. Nous recherchons un leader et un coach qui n'a pas peur d'être sur le terrain avec les représentants et les clients, côte à côte, afin de conclure les ventes. Quelqu'un qui élève la barre, fait grandir l'équipe, maintient la responsabilisation de tous et rend chaque vendeur meilleur.

À propos de nous :

Evvo est une entreprise dynamique des technologies propres qui a connu une croissance de plus de 700 % au cours des cinq dernières années. Nous nous appuyons sur les principes de l'économie circulaire pour simplifier la gestion des appareils mobiles pour les grandes entreprises et les gouvernements. Nous aidons à prolonger la durée de vie des téléphones intelligents et des tablettes tout en allégeant la charge de travail des équipes TI de nos clients, ce que nous appelons la gestion déléguée des appareils. Grâce à nos technologies et à nos processus de gestion, nos clients réalisent des économies réelles, renforcent la sécurité des données et libèrent leur personnel TI pour des projets plus stratégiques.

Chez Evvo, nous prospérons grâce à des idées ambitieuses et à fort impact. Nous visons à révolutionner notre secteur, à devenir le leader du marché et à sauver la planète — un appareil électronique à la fois.

Ce que vous ferez

Relever directement du PDG et faire progresser notre structure commerciale actuelle : établir le plan annuel et les priorités, et assumer la responsabilité des prévisions mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles.
Diriger, coacher et former une équipe grandissante de professionnels des ventes.
Observer des appels en direct, des réunions de découverte et des démonstrations selon un roulement établi, donner de la rétroaction le jour même et animer des formations pratiques (découverte, gestion des objections, discussions sur les prix, MEDDICS, jeux de rôle, révision d'appels).
Être sur le terrain chaque semaine : rencontrer les clients et partenaires aux côtés de vos représentants afin d'assurer la conclusion des affaires, bâtir des relations personnelles avec les dirigeants et partenaires clés, assister aux événements de l'industrie et co-diriger les opportunités stratégiques majeures en tant que sponsor exécutif.
Fixer les objectifs et mener des rencontres individuelles hebdomadaires, des revues de pipeline et des évaluations de rendement trimestrielles pour chaque membre de l'équipe.
Faire passer l'équipe de 3 à 5 ou 6 personnes d'ici la fin de l'année : être toujours en recrutement, prévoir les besoins en talents et exécuter un processus d'intégration structuré sur 30/60/90 jours pour chaque poste.
Renforcer la rétention et la croissance au sein de la base de clients installée : travailler avec le succès client sur le score de santé, le calendrier de renouvellement et les revues d'affaires trimestrielles, et identifier les opportunités de vente croisée et de montée en gamme.
Superviser le processus de vente, le CRM et les prévisions : maintenir des critères d'étape rigoureux, une discipline de suivi et des règles de passage de relais claires dans NetSuite, fournir un rapport hebdomadaire du pipeline et des prévisions mensuelles au PDG et au CFO, et améliorer continuellement le processus grâce aux données de gains/pertes.
Gérer la suite d'outils technologiques de vente (CRM NetSuite, Apollo.io, Claude AI), en maximiser l'utilisation et former l'équipe à la maîtrise de l'IA.
Avec le consultant en marketing externe, aligner le marketing et les campagnes ABM avec les priorités des ventes sur les comptes cibles. Effectuer des tests A/B avec des critères de réussite définis à l'avance, et veiller à ce que la documentation de vente reste pertinente et à jour.
Collaborer avec l'équipe produit : apporter des retours clients structurés et des analyses post-mortem sur les comptes gagnés et perdus afin d'améliorer continuellement l'adéquation produit-marché.
Soutenir les acquisitions : lorsque Evvo acquiert une entreprise, rejoindre l'équipe d'intégration sur le volet commercial. Évaluer la base de clients acquise, l'équipe de vente, le plan de rémunération et les offres, planifier l'intégration des équipes, des outils et du pipeline, puis diriger la com

jobs.title: Program Director - Program Delivery Executive
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Program Director – Program Delivery Executive based in Canada.

We are seeking an accomplished Program Director to lead the successful execution of complex enterprise software programs within the insurance technology sector. In this senior leadership role, you will oversee end-to-end program delivery, ensuring projects meet agreed milestones, budgets, timelines, and business objectives. You will manage multiple workstreams, lead international cross-functional teams, and establish strong governance frameworks that drive accountability and operational excellence. A key priority will be accelerating customer value realization through AI-enabled delivery models, streamlined SaaS implementations, and proactive risk management. Working closely with executive stakeholders and Customer Success teams, you will strengthen customer relationships while contributing to commercial growth and long-term account performance. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to shape innovative delivery practices and lead strategic transformation initiatives in a dynamic, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities

Program Delivery and Strategic Execution
Take full ownership of the program lifecycle, from initiation and planning through execution and closure, ensuring delivery remains on time, within scope, and within budget.
Oversee complex, multi-workstream programs involving software platform implementation, system integration, data migration, and business transformation.
Establish delivery strategies, governance structures, and execution standards that ensure consistency, transparency, and accountability.
Define and monitor time-to-value baselines, ensuring customers achieve measurable business outcomes as efficiently as possible.
Accelerate SaaS implementation cycles by promoting AI-led delivery practices and configuration-over-customization approaches.
Integrate AI-powered tools into program management activities, including status tracking, risk analysis, documentation, reporting, and execution monitoring.

Commercial Performance and Customer Value
Partner with Customer Success leadership to support commercial performance across customer accounts, including Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), account margins, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for account expansion, upselling, and cross-selling during program execution, translating customer needs into business growth opportunities.
Monitor financial performance, delivery costs, budgets, forecasts, and commercial commitments.
Ensure program milestones align with contractual obligations, billing triggers, and agreed commercial events.
Contribute to long-term customer value realization and strengthen customer relationships through consistent delivery performance.

Milestone Governance and Risk Management
Define, manage, and track program milestones, ensuring each phase has clear deliverables, definitions of done, and formal customer acceptance criteria.
Collaborate with customers to establish and agree on exit criteria at the beginning of each program phase.
Maintain strict scope control and manage changes through structured change orders aligned with contractual and delivery requirements.
Maintain an up-to-date risk and dependency register, identifying potential challenges early and implementing appropriate mitigation strategies.
Coordinate interdependencies across teams and workstreams, ensuring timely issue resolution and continuous delivery progress.

Insurance Industry Expertise and Customer Relationship Management
Develop a comprehensive understanding of customer business models, operational structures, insurance processes, and regulatory environments.
Apply strong insurance industry knowledge to guide implementation decisions and ensure solutions address customer-specific requirements.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including C-suite executives.
Serve as the primary program-level escalation point, addressing critical concerns and maintaining confidence throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Anticipate customer challenges and proactively resolve issues before they affect program performance or customer satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Resource Management
Coordinate multidisciplinary delivery teams comprising internal employees, offshore resources, systems integration partners, and customer-side stakeholders.
Ensure alignment, accountability, communication, and execution discipline across all participating teams.
Directly lead and develop Project Managers, establishing delivery standards, performance expectations, and professional development objectives.
Oversee the full talent lifecycle, including onboarding, capability development, performance management, and role transitions.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial awareness.
Work closely with Customer Success teams to ensure a structured transition between implementation delivery and long-term customer value management.
Represent the organization's technology vision and strategic positioning in customer environments, communicating the value of insurance-focused technology, AI innovation, and autonomous insurance capabilities.

Requirements

Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

new_jobs.title: Head of Sales │ Chef des ventes
new_jobs.description:
Head of Sales

A rare role: you report directly to the CEO and take over a strong, proven sales function, processes, lead generation, CRM, KPI dashboards, go to market strategy and metrics already in place, and take it further. We're looking for a leader and coach who isn't afraid to be in the trenches with the reps and the clients, side by side, so that deals get won. Someone who raises the bar, grows the team, keeps everybody accountable and makes every seller better.

About Us:

Evvo is a dynamic clean-tech company that has grown by over 700% in the last five years. We lean on circular economy principles to make mobile device management a breeze for big companies and governments. We help stretch the lifespan of smartphones and tablets while lightening the load for our clients' IT teams, what we call delegated device management. Thanks to our tech and management processes, our clients see real savings, tighter data security, and free up their IT folks for more strategic projects.

At Evvo, we thrive on ambitious, high-impact ideas. We aim to revolutionize our industry, become the market leader, and save the planet—one electronic device at a time.

What You Will Do

Report directly to the CEO and take our current sales structure further: set the annual plan and priorities, and own the monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts.
Lead, coach and train a growing team of sales professionals.
Shadow live calls, discovery meetings and demos on a set rotation, give same-day feedback, and run hands-on training (discovery, objection handling, pricing conversations, MEDDICS, role-plays, call reviews).
Be on the ground every week: meet clients and partners alongside your reps so deals get won, build personal relationships with key executives and partners, attend industry events, and co-lead the largest strategic opportunities as executive sponsor.
Set objectives and run weekly 1:1s, pipeline reviews and quarterly performance reviews for every team member.
Grow the team from 3 to 5 or 6 people by the end of the year: always be recruiting, forecast talent needs and run a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding for each role.
Strengthen retention and growth in the installed base: work with Customer Success on health scoring, the renewal calendar and quarterly business reviews, and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
Own the sales process, CRM and forecast: keep stage criteria, next-step discipline and handoff rules in NetSuite sharp, deliver a weekly pipeline report and a monthly forecast to the CEO and CFO, and keep improving the process with win/loss data.
Own the sales tech stack (NetSuite CRM, Apollo.io, Claude AI), get more out of it, and train the team to be AI-fluent.
With the external marketing consultant, align marketing and ABM campaigns with Sales priorities on target accounts. Run A/B tests with success criteria set in advance, and ensure sales assets stay sharp and current.
Work with the product team: bring structured client feedback and post-mortems on won and lost accounts to keep improving product-market fit.
Support acquisitions: when Evvo acquires a company, join the integration team on the commercial side. Assess the acquired client base, sales team, comp plan and offers, plan the integration of teams, tools and pipeline, then lead client communication and cross-selling.

In 12 Months, You Will Have

Lifted team performance through hands-on coaching: stronger discovery, pitching and closing, with more deals won alongside you.
Grown the team from 3 to 5 or 6 people by year-end and built a confident, accountable group: written quarterly objectives, a steady coaching rhythm and new sellers ramping on plan.
Diversified our client base with new logos, backed by a pipeline that comfortably covers the target.
Delivered a forecast the CEO and CFO can trust, with a next step and a date on every open opportunity.
Secured the installed base: every renewal reviewed well ahead of its end date and every at-risk account covered by a documented action plan.
Aligned Sales and Marketing: ABM campaigns focused on target accounts, up-to-date sales assets, and every A/B test closed with a documented decision.
Taken our sales process further: sharper stage discipline in the CRM, refined every month from win/loss data and what the team learns.

What We Are Looking For

A track record as a leader and coach of a sales team: you have built and developed elite sales professionals, taking into account coaching, tough love, and hard managerial decisions when needed.
Experience growing and diversifying a B2B technology or managed-services client base. Telecom, mobility management or IT services is an asset.
Mastery of complex enterprise sales with long cycles (6 to 18 months) and multiple decision-makers, with credibility in front of C-level buyers and public-sector procurement.
A boots on the ground mentality: you are not afraid to be in the room with reps, partners and clients. Most of your week is spent with them, and the rest on planning, execution and reporting.
Experience scaling an existing sales function.
A natural relationship builder, at ease hosting partners, clients and executives.
Discipline, accountability and data accuracy (CRM, forecasting) as non-negotiables.
A high degree of initiative: you don't wait to be asked, you execute fast.
High comfort with AI tools to scale the team.
Fluency in French and English.
Passionate about making a positive impact on the environment.
A plus: knowledge of device lifecycle management, MDM, ITSM (ServiceNow), Managed Services or Telecom expense management.

What We Offer You

Full-time, permanent position.
Minimum of 3 weeks vacation + additional time off during the holiday season.
Flexible hybrid work (minimum 3 days per week in our modern offices in the Old Port of Montréal; the rest remote or on client and partner sites). Travel outside the city about once a month, for 2 to 4 days.
Group insurance and RRSP
‍⚕ 24/7 online access to a doctor for you and your family
Top-tier tech and AI tools so you can perform at your full potential.
‍‍ Humans first: scheduling flexibility for the unexpected, a listening ear, and victories we celebrate together. Here, you are not a number.
Team events, happy hours, and celebrations for our major successes
Be part of a dynamic and dedicated team, committed to creating tools and solutions that make a real difference for our planet.

What to expect next?

We value your time and clear communication. Here are the steps in our hiring process:

Discovery interview with our Talent acquisition Manager (30 min): a phone discussion to get to know each other, discuss the role and your aspirations.
Second interview with recruiting manager (1h): a more in-depth discussion via video conference about the role, your vision for growth and your experience.
Practical interview with our CEO (1h30): you receive a case 72 hours ahead and present your approach in our offices. You'll also meet a member of your future team.
Job Offer, References & Background Check: The moment we've been waiting for! We make you an offer, speak with your references, and conduct a background check.
Onboarding: Welcome to Evvo! We've prepared everything for a smooth arrival: your tools are waiting for you, and the team is excited to meet and train you so you can thrive quickly.

Our Hiring Philosophy:

We like to keep things moving! We commit to keeping you informed, regardless of the outcome; here, we don't "ghost" anyone. We aim for a thorough and rigorous evaluation, but always efficient.

Chef des ventes

Un rôle rare : vous relevez directement du PDG et prenez en charge une fonction commerciale solide et éprouvée, des processus, la génération de pistes, un CRM, des tableaux de bord de KPI, une stratégie d'accès au marché et des métriques déjà en place, pour les amener encore plus loin. Nous recherchons un leader et un coach qui n'a pas peur d'être sur le terrain avec les représentants et les clients, côte à côte, afin de conclure les ventes. Quelqu'un qui élève la barre, fait grandir l'équipe, maintient la responsabilisation de tous et rend chaque vendeur meilleur.

À propos de nous :

Evvo est une entreprise dynamique des technologies propres qui a connu une croissance de plus de 700 % au cours des cinq dernières années. Nous nous appuyons sur les principes de l'économie circulaire pour simplifier la gestion des appareils mobiles pour les grandes entreprises et les gouvernements. Nous aidons à prolonger la durée de vie des téléphones intelligents et des tablettes tout en allégeant la charge de travail des équipes TI de nos clients, ce que nous appelons la gestion déléguée des appareils. Grâce à nos technologies et à nos processus de gestion, nos clients réalisent des économies réelles, renforcent la sécurité des données et libèrent leur personnel TI pour des projets plus stratégiques.

Chez Evvo, nous prospérons grâce à des idées ambitieuses et à fort impact. Nous visons à révolutionner notre secteur, à devenir le leader du marché et à sauver la planète — un appareil électronique à la fois.

Ce que vous ferez

Relever directement du PDG et faire progresser notre structure commerciale actuelle : établir le plan annuel et les priorités, et assumer la responsabilité des prévisions mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles.
Diriger, coacher et former une équipe grandissante de professionnels des ventes.
Observer des appels en direct, des réunions de découverte et des démonstrations selon un roulement établi, donner de la rétroaction le jour même et animer des formations pratiques (découverte, gestion des objections, discussions sur les prix, MEDDICS, jeux de rôle, révision d'appels).
Être sur le terrain chaque semaine : rencontrer les clients et partenaires aux côtés de vos représentants afin d'assurer la conclusion des affaires, bâtir des relations personnelles avec les dirigeants et partenaires clés, assister aux événements de l'industrie et co-diriger les opportunités stratégiques majeures en tant que sponsor exécutif.
Fixer les objectifs et mener des rencontres individuelles hebdomadaires, des revues de pipeline et des évaluations de rendement trimestrielles pour chaque membre de l'équipe.
Faire passer l'équipe de 3 à 5 ou 6 personnes d'ici la fin de l'année : être toujours en recrutement, prévoir les besoins en talents et exécuter un processus d'intégration structuré sur 30/60/90 jours pour chaque poste.
Renforcer la rétention et la croissance au sein de la base de clients installée : travailler avec le succès client sur le score de santé, le calendrier de renouvellement et les revues d'affaires trimestrielles, et identifier les opportunités de vente croisée et de montée en gamme.
Superviser le processus de vente, le CRM et les prévisions : maintenir des critères d'étape rigoureux, une discipline de suivi et des règles de passage de relais claires dans NetSuite, fournir un rapport hebdomadaire du pipeline et des prévisions mensuelles au PDG et au CFO, et améliorer continuellement le processus grâce aux données de gains/pertes.
Gérer la suite d'outils technologiques de vente (CRM NetSuite, Apollo.io, Claude AI), en maximiser l'utilisation et former l'équipe à la maîtrise de l'IA.
Avec le consultant en marketing externe, aligner le marketing et les campagnes ABM avec les priorités des ventes sur les comptes cibles. Effectuer des tests A/B avec des critères de réussite définis à l'avance, et veiller à ce que la documentation de vente reste pertinente et à jour.
Collaborer avec l'équipe produit : apporter des retours clients structurés et des analyses post-mortem sur les comptes gagnés et perdus afin d'améliorer continuellement l'adéquation produit-marché.
Soutenir les acquisitions : lorsque Evvo acquiert une entreprise, rejoindre l'équipe d'intégration sur le volet commercial. Évaluer la base de clients acquise, l'équipe de vente, le plan de rémunération et les offres, planifier l'intégration des équipes, des outils et du pipeline, puis diriger la com
